verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Pro is a hardware processor, not a service or account that holds user data, so exporting all of your data in open formats and leaving is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip ships any data-export capability. Thunderbolt 5 transfer speed is a hardware I/O spec, not a data-portability feature, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
